protocol: Fold=(run_number-1)%4. Score fold k; validate fold (k+1)%4; train remaining two. Never split one recording. All three manoeuvre families present in each role. Both fixed NN variants use the same training/validation/scoring windows. Every recording scored once by a model that did not train or early-stop on it. Previously exposed recordings mean all scores remain developmental.

variants.mlp_original: Original per-axis target standardization, random output initialization, validation normalized MSE
variants.mlp_shared: Shared residual scale with zero origin, zero initial residual output, validation MAE proportional to physical-unit MAE; epoch zero is eligible
